name: NVR5216-16P-EI Dahua 16 каналов 1U 16 PoE 2 жестких диска

attributes.AI by Recorder: Face detection; face recognition; perimeter protection; SMD Plus

attributes.Motor Vehicle Attributes: License plate, plate color, vehicle body, vehicle model, vehicle logo, calling, seatbelt, vehicle interior, vehicle registration location.
attributes.Non-motor Vehicle Attributes: Vehicle model, vehicle color, number of persons, helmet.
attributes.License Plate Database Capacity: 1. Create up to 20,000 plate numbers. 2. Blocklist and allowlist
